messages:
anne-ops: :rotating_light: seeing a bunch of GPU nodes in us-west-2 with keystore decrypt failures, start of spike around 08:12 UTC. error is 'decrypt failed: AccessDenied' from keystore client.

sam-infra: confirmed, I can repro on a staging node. looks correlated with last night's IAM role change + a VPC egress ACL tighten that went out at ~02:00.

mike-sre: stack traces show the agent can't reach the KMS endpoint — but AccessDenied suggests credentials/policy too. do we have a recent role-boundary change for the gpu-autoscale role?

tina-sec: I pushed the org-wide IAM boundary tweak last night to block kms:Decrypt for roles without the new tag. It was supposed to target service accounts but maybe the node role is missing the tag. investigating.

oncall-jordan: currently impact: ~22% of us-west-2 GPU pool failing onboarding, requests are being retried and causing backlog + tokenized inference throttling. Canary fallbacks to dedicated cpu pools are running but cost will jump if we don't fix quickly.

sam-infra: good catch on the tag thing. quick mitigation: we can add a temporary inline policy to the gpu node role granting kms:Decrypt for the keystore key ARN, or revert the boundary. which is less risky?

tina-sec: prefer scoped inline allow on the gpu role for the specific key ARN (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/ab12cd34-...). Revert the whole boundary would be noisy. I'll draft the policy now.

anne-ops: also noticed VPC egress ACL denies to 169.254.169.254? not that, but we did tighten egress to only allow privatelink endpoints and KMS. Deploy-bot shows a privatelink endpoint update at 01:58. If endpoints are misconfigured nodes will fall back to public KMS and hit deny.

mike-sre: action plan: (1) tina apply scoped inline allow to gpu role; (2) sam validate privatelink endpoint for KMS in us-west-2; (3) anne roll ephemeral routing policy to allow KMS public endpoints for nodes in the warm pool as emergency fallback; (4) oncall-jordan monitor backlog and if stable start draining failed nodes and rejoin.

oncall-jordan: doing (4) now, backlog reduced slightly after retries but still ~8 nodes in error state.

tina-sec: policy applied to gpu role: attached inline policy granting kms:Decrypt for the keystore key ARN. please verify. policy id TKT-8271.

sam-infra: verified privatelink was healthy but the endpoint's security-group didn't include the gpu node SG due to a merge conflict in the TF change. I updated the endpoint SG to include gpu nodes, ran terraform apply. that should fix pathing to privatelink.

mike-sre: running small verification: on a broken node now curl the privatelink DNS to check connectivity, and test keystore decrypt with the agent client.

anne-ops: quick test results: after SG fix and policy add, decrypts succeed and keystore client reports OK. rejoining nodes now. :thumbsup:

oncall-jordan: rejoin completed for 7 nodes, remaining 1 node still failing with 'EC2 IMDS unreachable' which looks like misapplied NACL from the egress tighten.

sam-infra: found NACL deny entry for ephemeral ports 32768-61000 that was applied to the subnet used by that host. removing that rule for the subnet now.

mike-sre: monitoring pool metrics — warmup throughput back to normal, queue latency stabilized. please keep an eye on cost dashboard; fallback to CPU pools for 40min pushed cost ~+12% for the hour.

tina-sec: I'm opening follow-ups: (1) enforce tag automation so node roles can't miss the required tag (TKT-8272), (2) add a test in the TF PR template to ensure privatelink SG includes node SGs (TKT-8273), (3) run a small canary that validates IAM boundary changes won't block kms:Decrypt for existing service roles (TKT-8274).

anne-ops: documented the live mitigation steps in the runbook under 'keystore-decrypt-failure' and flagged for a postmortem if we don't catch the root cause in the follow-ups.

oncall-jordan: creating an incident record and tagging eng-sre + eng-infra + eng-security, summary and timeline in the incident doc.

mike-sre: great work team. let's keep the postmortem focused on change windows, Terraform merge safety, and measurable alerts for keystore decrypt rate.

tina-sec: one more ask: add an audit log alarm for KMS AccessDenied spikes (low-noise threshold) so we catch this before onboarding hits production.

anne-ops: noted. also adding a cost alert for emergency fallback usage >10% baseline.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-21T01:58Z privatelink-sg-update applied by sam-infra (plan ok)

mike-sre: closing thread for now — any regressions reopen. :white_check_mark:
